scripts.db:generate: prisma generate --config prisma7.config.ts && prisma generate --config prisma.audit.config.ts
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:generate && npm run db:create-audit && prisma migrate deploy --config prisma.audit.config.ts && node --import tsx src/scripts/migrateLegacyAuditLogs.ts && prisma migrate deploy --config prisma7.config.ts
scripts.db:count: docker compose exec postgres psql -U nestsms -d audit_logs_dev -c 'select count(*) from audit_logs;'
scripts.demo:reset: docker compose exec redis redis-cli flushall && docker compose exec postgres psql -U nestsms -d audit_dev -c 'TRUNCATE outbox_events;' && docker compose exec postgres psql -U nestsms -d audit_logs_dev -c 'TRUNCATE audit_logs;'
scripts.db:latest: docker compose exec postgres psql -U nestsms -d audit_logs_dev -c 'select event_type, actor_id, resource_type, resource_id, occurred_at from audit_logs order by occurred_at desc limit 10;'
